    SELECT 
        res.driver_id,
        r.year,
        MIN(r.round) AS min_round,

    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY res.driver_id, r.year
),
first_race_con AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.driver_id,

        res.constructor_id AS first_constructor
    FROM season_stats ss

),
last_race_con AS (

        ss.year,
        res.constructor_id AS last_constructor
    FROM season_stats ss

    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = ss.year AND r.round = ss.max_round

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH first_last AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.driver_id,
         MIN(r.round) AS min_round,
         MAX(r.round) AS max_round,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) AS n_rounds
  FROM drives d
  JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id AND r.year = d.year
  WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
),
first_c AS (
  SELECT fl.year, fl.driver_id, res.constructor_id AS first_constructor
  FROM first_last fl
  JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = fl.driver_id
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id AND r.year = fl.year
  WHERE r.round = fl.min_round
),
last_c AS (
  SELECT fl.year, fl.driver_id, res.constructor_id AS last_constructor
  FROM first_last fl
  JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = fl.driver_id
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id AND r.year = fl.year
  WHERE r.round = fl.max_round
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM first_last fl
JOIN first_c fc ON fc.year = fl.year AND fc.driver_id = fl.driver_id
JOIN last_c lc ON lc.year = fl.year AND lc.driver_id = fl.driver_id
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = fl.driver_id
WHERE fl.n_rounds >= 2 AND fc.first_constructor = lc.last_constructor
ORDER BY fl.year, fl.driver_id
LIMIT 1;

    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY res.driver_id, r.year
),
first_race_con AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.driver_id,
        ss.year,
        res.constructor_id AS first_constructor
    FROM season_stats ss
    JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = ss.driver_id
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = ss.year AND r.round = ss.min_round
),
last_race_con AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.driver_id,
        ss.year,
        res.constructor_id AS last_constructor
    FROM season_stats ss
    JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = ss.driver_id
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = ss.year AND r.round = ss.max_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.forename,
    d.surname
FROM season_stats ss
JOIN first_race_con frc ON ss.driver_id = frc.driver_id AND ss.year = frc.year
JOIN last_race_con lrc ON ss.driver_id = lrc.driver_id AND ss.year = lrc.year
JOIN drivers d ON ss.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE ss.n_rounds >= 2
  AND frc.first_constructor = lrc.last_constructor
ORDER BY d.forename, d.surname
